```{r}
#| label: setup
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

data_dir <- "../data"

col_types_publications <- cols(
  id = col_character(),
  publication_type = col_character(),
  title = col_character(),
  authors = col_character(),
  journal_or_venue = col_character(),
  year = col_double(),
  month = col_double(),
  day = col_double(),
  DOI = col_character(),
  PMID = col_character(),
  url = col_character(),
  author_position = col_character(),
  mentee_author = col_logical(),
  multi_institution = col_logical(),
  status = col_character(),
  notes = col_character()
)

publications <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "publications.csv"), col_types = col_types_publications)
grants <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "grants.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
effort_by_year <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "effort_by_year.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
presentations <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "presentations.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
teaching <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "teaching.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
service <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "service.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
service_log <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "service_log.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
mentoring <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "mentoring.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
awards <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "awards.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
reviewer_relationships <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "reviewer_relationships.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

grants <- grants %>% mutate(start_year = as.integer(substr(start_date, 1, 4)))

money <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "", paste0("$", formatC(x, format = "d", big.mark = ",")))
}

blank_na <- function(x) tidyr::replace_na(x, "")

#' Render a data frame as an interactive table
#'
#' Wraps `DT::datatable()` so every dashboard table gets the same search box,
#' click-to-sort column headers, and per-column filter boxes. Replaces the
#' static `knitr::kable()` tables, which had no way to search or sort (task note
#' "Create an Academic Database and Dashboard", 2026-09-25 dashboard subtasks).
#'
#' Long free-text columns (any character or factor column with a value over 40
#' characters, e.g. titles and journals) wrap at a minimum width; every other
#' column stays on one line. The table then grows wider than a narrow card and
#' scrolls horizontally instead of squeezing all columns to fit (styles in
#' `dashboard/styles.css`).
#'
#' Small tables (`small_max` rows or fewer, e.g. the Teaching & Mentoring cards)
#' drop the search box, filter row, and row-count line and keep only sorting.
#' Those controls took most of a short card's height, leaving room for about
#' one row, and add little when every row is already visible.
#'
#' @param df A data frame whose column names are already display-ready.
#' @param page_length Rows shown per page before paginating.
#' @param small_max Largest row count that gets the simplified, sort-only table.
#' @return A `datatables` htmlwidget that Quarto sizes to fill its card.
interactive_table <- function(df, page_length = 25, small_max = 15) {
  is_small <- nrow(df) <= small_max

  # DataTables column targets are 0-based. unname() matters: a named vector
  # serializes to a JSON object, which DataTables silently ignores.
  is_long_text <- vapply(
    df,
    function(col) (is.character(col) || is.factor(col)) &&
      max(nchar(as.character(col)), 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 40,
    logical(1)
  )
  wrap_targets <- as.list(unname(which(is_long_text)) - 1)

  DT::datatable(
    df,
    rownames = FALSE,
    # Per-column filter boxes above the headers; text columns get a search box
    # and numeric columns get a range slider. Omitted for small tables.
    filter = if (is_small) "none" else "top",
    # Let the widget fill the dashboard card instead of overflowing it.
    fillContainer = TRUE,
    options = list(
      pageLength = page_length,
      # DataTables layout string: "f" search box, "i" row-count line, "t" the
      # table itself. Small tables show the table only.
      dom = if (is_small) "t" else "fit",
      # Keep the input order (already sorted in each chunk) until a header is clicked.
      order = list(),
      # Scroll inside the card rather than growing the page.
      scrollY = "100%",
      scrollCollapse = TRUE,
      # Scroll sideways when the columns' natural widths exceed the card.
      scrollX = TRUE,
      # autoWidth lets DT honor the fixed width on long-text columns, which
      # then wrap at that width instead of stretching to their full length.
      autoWidth = TRUE,
      columnDefs = list(list(className = "dt-wrap", width = "22em", targets = wrap_targets))
    )
  )
}

#' Render a ggplot as an interactive chart that fills its card
#'
#' Converts a ggplot with `plotly::ggplotly()`. The Overview charts used to be
#' static images drawn at knitr's default figure size, which Quarto scaled down
#' to fit each card, shrinking the axis text and leaving empty space (task note
#' "Create an Academic Database and Dashboard", 2026-09-25 dashboard subtasks).
#' A plotly widget resizes to its card at any window size and keeps its text at
#' a fixed pixel size.
#'
#' Each chart supplies a `text` aesthetic with a formatted hover label, so the
#' tooltip shows readable values (e.g. "$3,056,003") instead of internal column
#' names and raw numbers.
#'
#' @param p A ggplot object with a `text` aesthetic for the hover label.
#' @return A `plotly` htmlwidget that Quarto sizes to fill its card.
interactive_plot <- function(p) {
  plotly::ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>%
    # Hide plotly's zoom/pan/download toolbar; these are simple bar charts and
    # the toolbar covers part of a small card.
    plotly::config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
}
```

## Row {height="20%"}

```{r}

sum(publications$publication_type == "peer_reviewed_article")

money(sum(grants$total_cost[grants$status %in% c("funded", "completed")], na.rm = TRUE))
```

## Row {height="40%"}

### Column {width="60%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Publications by Year"
p <- publications %>%
  count(year) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, text = paste0(year, ": ", n, " publications"))) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2c3e50") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Publications") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15)
interactive_plot(p)
```

### Column {width="40%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Publications by Type"
p <- publications %>%
  count(publication_type) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(publication_type, n), y = n, text = paste0(publication_type, ": ", n))) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2c3e50") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15)
interactive_plot(p)
```

## Row {height="40%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Grant Funding by Start Year"
p <- grants %>%
  filter(!is.na(start_year)) %>%
  group_by(start_year) %>%
  summarise(total_cost = sum(total_cost, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = start_year, y = total_cost, text = paste0(start_year, ": ", money(total_cost)))) +
  geom_col(fill = "#18795a") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar(scale = 1e-6, suffix = "M")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Award amount") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15)
interactive_plot(p)
```

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "All Grants"
grants %>%
  arrange(desc(start_date)) %>%
  transmute(
    Title = title,
    Role = role,
    Sponsor = funder_abbreviation,
    `Award #` = blank_na(award_number),
    Status = status,
    # Kept numeric (not pre-formatted text) so the column sorts by amount;
    # formatCurrency() below handles the display.
    `Total Cost` = total_cost,
    Start = start_date,
    End = end_date,
    `Effort %` = effort_percent
  ) %>%
  # Dropdown filters for the controlled-vocabulary columns.
  mutate(across(c(Role, Sponsor, Status), factor)) %>%
  interactive_table() %>%
  DT::formatCurrency("Total Cost", digits = 0)
```

# Publications

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "All Publications"
publications %>%
  arrange(desc(year), desc(month)) %>%
  transmute(
    Year = year,
    Title = title,
    Journal = journal_or_venue,
    Type = publication_type,
    Position = author_position,
    Status = status
  ) %>%
  # Factors make DT show a dropdown of the controlled-vocabulary values in the
  # column filter, instead of a free-text box.
  mutate(across(c(Type, Position, Status), factor)) %>%
  interactive_table()
```
